Package release.support

Class MavenSupport

java.lang.Object
release.support.MavenSupport
public final class MavenSupport extends Object
Provides support for Maven-related operations during the release process.

  • Method Details

    • installModulesAndDependencies

      public static void installModulesAndDependencies(List<String> modules) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Installs the given modules into the local repository together with every project module they depend on (the parent POM, paint-shared-utils, paint-ui-common, ...).

      The modules are later built one by one from their own folder, which only works if what they depend on is already installed. Maven works out that list itself (-am), so a new library module does not have to be added here by hand.

      Throws:
      IOException
      InterruptedException

    • versionsSetCommand

      public static List<String> versionsSetCommand(String newVersion, boolean allModules)
      The Maven command that sets the project version. With allModules false only the parent POM gets the new version (and the modules' references to it).

    • buildInstallers

      public static void buildInstallers(String version, Path destDir) throws IOException, InterruptedException
      Builds the installers (module packaging: the macOS .pkg and the Windows setup.exe) and copies them into destDir. Both are asked for by their exact name, so a missing or stale installer stops the release.
      Throws:
      IOException
      InterruptedException

    • requireMakensis

      public static void requireMakensis()
      Stops before anything is changed if makensis (needed for the Windows installer) is not installed. Looks where packaging/pom.xml looks: the Homebrew folders and the PATH.
